name: DecryptTextWithAes
label: Decrypt Text with AES
description: Decrypts a Base64-encoded string using AES with optional key hashing for short keys.

fields.name: Ciphertext
fields.label: Ciphertext to Decrypt
fields.description: The Base64-encoded encrypted text to decrypt.

fields.name: Key
fields.label: Decryption Key
fields.description: The key used for decryption. If it's shorter than required, it will be hashed to a valid length (16/24/32 bytes).

fields.name: IV
fields.label: Initialization Vector (IV)
fields.description: The initialization vector (must be exactly 16 characters long).

fields.name: DecryptedText
fields.label: Decrypted Text Result
fields.description: Outputs the decrypted plain text after decryption.
